# Karim Khalifeh

> Senior full-stack developer based in Beirut, open to remote senior roles. 4+ years building production web applications on Laravel, React, and Node.js, with applied AI features (LLM tool calling, structured outputs, usage metering, RAG). At Storiad (2022–present) owned the backend architecture and data layer of a near-1,000-user publishing platform, led its migration off WordPress, and shipped its AI assistant, Stripe billing, and site-provisioning infrastructure.

## Pages

- [Home](https://karimkhalifeh.com): Featured work, experience at Storiad, side projects, and contact.
- [About](https://karimkhalifeh.com/about): Background, toolkit, education, and certifications. MSc in clinical and health psychology (Bangor University) before moving into full-stack development. Works natively in English and Arabic, professionally in French.

## Work

- [Storiad](https://karimkhalifeh.com/work/storiad): Software developer, 2022–present. Owned the Laravel backend of the logged-in app for self-published authors — AI assistant with OpenAI tool calling and per-tier usage metering, Publisher Edition B2B tier with per-seat Stripe billing, one-click author-site provisioning via Laravel Forge, and a read-only public demo environment.
- [Golden Land Real Estate](https://karimkhalifeh.com/work/golden-land): Solo build that migrated a real-estate platform off a legacy CMS with zero data loss — 7,953 listings, 57 agents, 37K+ images — with a full admin dashboard and Cloudflare R2 image uploads.
- [Trublu Technical](https://karimkhalifeh.com/work/trublu): Marketing site for a Beirut home-services firm — per-service pages and a WhatsApp-driven booking funnel, with full technical SEO.
- [Worktales](https://karimkhalifeh.com/work/worktales): Full redesign of a B2B sales-talent site, rebuilt page by page for employers and job-seeking salespeople.

## Side projects

- [Reorder-Intelligence System](https://github.com/Khalifeh11/inventory-reorder-intelligence): Python/Streamlit/SQLite proof of concept that turns ERP sales history into reorder recommendations, with a Claude layer writing weekly procurement briefings and per-SKU explanations.
- [Voice Mood Journal](https://github.com/Khalifeh11/mood-journaling-app): React Native voice-to-structured-data pipeline using GPT-4o-mini function calling.
